slot.brief: A body released/thrown vertically under gravity (or distance travelled in the nth second); use one kinematic equation to find time, speed or distance.

stem: A ball is thrown vertically upward with a speed of $30$ m s$^{-1}$. Taking $g=10$ m s$^{-2}$, its speed after $2$ s is

verdicts.working: Using v = u - gt = 30 - (10)(2) = 10 m s^-1, so the speed is 10 m s^-1.

working:
$v=u-gt=30-(10)(2)=10$ m s$^{-1}$

Independent check: Using v = u - gt = 30 - (10)(2) = 10 m s^-1, so the speed is 10 m s^-1.
solution:
For upward motion, $v=u-gt$.
$$v=30-(10)(2)=10\text{ m s}^{-1}$$
Hence, the speed after $2$ s is $10$ m s$^{-1}$.
